evidence_limits.chronological_split_basis: The control's whole operating window is 2026-09-01..2026-09-08 and the earlier retained-policy study already examined it. No genuinely unexamined later period exists, so every result here is EXPLORATORY. No selection/evaluation split is claimed.
known_gaps: No cohort event has a certified game_final_outcomes row; the operational score of record is used and is verified against every settled position.
No odds snapshot carries the is_closing flag; CLV uses the settlement engine's last-same-book-before-first-pitch definition and covers about half of the selections.
final_at is null for every cohort game, so intraday settlement sequencing is not recorded; the staking replay advances bankroll at slate-date boundaries.
Odds collection stopped at 2026-09-07 20:44, so the 2026-09-08 slate has no usable quote at any cutoff and contributes to availability counts only.
evidence_limits.weekly_block_basis: One week of slates cannot support a weekly-block inference at any number of bootstrap repetitions. None was run.

position_creation_defect.not_fixed_here: Changing this check would create positions, which this assignment does not authorise. It is reported for an explicit later decision.
position_creation_defect.summary: 1 qualifying control selection(s) never became an official position because the decision's four-decimal price does not equal the snapshot's full-precision price within the 1e-9 identity tolerance in _create_canonical_position. This is an arithmetic binding defect, not a policy rejection.

collection_requirements: Restore odds ingestion so a fresh two-sided moneyline quote exists at the cutoff for the majority of events. This is the binding constraint: 63 of 99 non-selections are price availability, not policy.
Capture a genuine closing price for every selection (a snapshot inside the final minutes, flagged is_closing) so CLV coverage stops being partial.
Persist final_at on every settled game so bankroll sequencing is exact.
Backfill certified game_final_outcomes rows for the live window so the outcome join no longer depends on the operational score.

frozen_before_collection.candidate: R0@0.0175 (adjusted-edge floor 0.0175; every other rule unchanged)
frozen_before_collection.control: R0@0.0200 (the live policy, unchanged and still governing)
frozen_before_collection.decision_rule: The candidate is nominated for activation only if it leads on the primary metric over at least the minimum sample AND does not worsen Brier or log loss.

minimum_sample.reasoning: The candidate differs from the control on roughly one selection per three slate days at the current rate, so 30 marginal settlements is about 90 slate days -- a full extension of the season, not a week.

prospective_protocol.purpose: Accumulate enough independent settled selections to separate a 1.75 pt floor from the 2.0 pt control at all.
stop_rules: Stop and report if the candidate and control still differ on fewer than 10 settled selections after 45 slate days -- the floor is then not the binding constraint and the study should not continue.
Never re-run the same window with more configurations; more cells do not create more evidence.
prospective_protocol.unit_of_observation: one distinct event, one final-pregame decision of record

sensitivity.verdict: The entire matrix separates on three settled events. One of them (SF @ NYM, 2026-09-05, +145) alone decides whether the 0.0175 floor outranks the control. No threshold can be nominated from this.

strict_comparison.note: V1 never produces a QUALIFIED_BET in this window and owns no position; its readiness>=70 gate and CONFIRMED-starter requirement are both unsatisfiable in this configuration.
strict_comparison.relationship: separate historical strict comparison; not pooled with the control
